tasks.description: Fix UTC timestamp bug so Data Last Pulled reflects local date/time (America/New_York). Root cause: dashboard.get_last_updated_time() takes max() of naive-UTC DB created_time string and naive-local generated_at string; UTC wins and app.js new Date() renders it as tomorrow.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: generated_at is tz-aware ISO in America/New_York; 2026-10-14T20:37:44-07:00 renders as October 14; UI shows date+time+zone.

tasks.description: Pre-compute hourly actuals as static JSON (hourly_actuals.json keyed by date, full history, also embedded in payloads.js) in the hourly Action, bucketed in America/New_York, 24 zero-filled buckets/day; also snapshot each day forecast going forward; reconstructed day-of-week baseline excluding the picked date. Optional local route /api/analytics/hourly_actuals?date= serves same payload.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Given YYYY-MM-DD returns exactly 24 buckets (hour 0-23, zero-filled) bucketed in America/New_York, from UTC-stored timestamps.

tasks.description: Date picker (future dates disabled, default today) in existing hourly forecast view; D3 chart (d3_charts.js) overlays actuals and baseline (labeled reconstructed). Display Data Last Pulled as "October 14, 2026 at 11:38 PM EDT".
